description: Unit test class for ModifyFeaturePropertiesStrategy, testing modifications of feature properties within 'Thing' objects in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for Verify the behavior of ModifyFeaturePropertiesStrategy with different scenarios.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static test data, notably feature ID and modified properties.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up a new instance of the strategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the strategy implementation is immutable.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertiesOfThingWithoutFeatures
methods.description: Tests error response when attempting to modify feature properties on a Thing with no features.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertiesOfThingWithoutThatFeature
methods.description: Tests error response when attempting to modify a feature that does not exist on the Thing.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertiesOfFeatureWithoutProperties
methods.description: Tests the creation of feature properties where none previously existed.

methods.name: modifyExistingFeatureProperties
methods.description: Tests successfully modifying existing feature properties.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertiesSoThatThingGetsTooLarge
methods.description: Tests that modification which would cause the Thing to exceed size limits throws an exception.
